world.setting: Little Kilton and Amersham, Buckinghamshire, England; police station interview rooms, residential driveways, woods, abandoned industrial buildings and courtroom
world.register: contemporary psychological thriller, investigative true-crime podcaster, stalker trauma, forensic cover-up

pip.name: Pip Fitz-Amobi
pip.role: traumatised amateur sleuth turned calculated forensic orchestrator
pip.look: an exhausted eighteen-year-old girl with dark brown hair in a loose low ponytail, dark circles under guarded hazel eyes, oversized knitted olive jumper and dark jeans

ravi.name: Ravi Singh
ravi.role: Pip's steadfast partner who compromises his own moral innocence to protect her
ravi.look: a warm-faced nineteen-year-old British-Indian young man, thick dark wavy hair, warm dark eyes, dark navy chore jacket over a grey crewneck t-shirt

jason.name: Jason Bell
jason.role: Andie Bell's father, respected local business owner unmasked as the serial duct-tape killer
jason.look: a cold imposing middle-aged man in his late forties, neatly parted brown-grey hair, sharp jawline, high-end navy quilted jacket over a dark sweater

max.name: Max Hastings
max.role: wealthy unpunished serial predator whom Pip frames for Jason Bell's murder
max.look: a smug entitled twenty-one-year-old young man with styled blond hair, sharp aristocratic features, tailored designer jacket and crisp collar

hawkins.name: DI Hawkins
hawkins.role: dismissive local police detective who refuses to investigate Pip's stalker
hawkins.look: a weary cynical police detective in his early fifties, thinning grey hair, rumpled charcoal grey suit and loosened dark tie

luke.name: Luke Eaton
luke.role: local dealer from whom Pip illegally buys sleeping pills to blunt her trauma
luke.look: a guarded young man in his mid-twenties, shaved head, heavily tattooed neck, black oversized hoodie

cara.name: Cara Ward
cara.role: Pip's loyal lifelong best friend whose home provides an unwitting alibi
cara.look: an affectionate eighteen-year-old girl with shoulder-length warm brown hair, soft expressive features, colourful patterned cardigan

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.role: the host voice analyzing the psychological deconstruction
narrator.look: a neutral narrator figure, analytical presence

office.look: the cold, sterile police interrogation room at Amersham station

room.look: the abandoned Green Scene storage warehouse where Jason Bell abducts Pip

street.look: the quiet residential driveway in Little Kilton marked with chalk figures and dead pigeons

bedroom.look: Pip's claustrophobic bedroom where sleepless nights and investigation pinboards consume her

forest.look: the dark isolated woods outside Little Kilton where the ambush occurs

court.look: the formal courtroom where Max Hastings smirked and walked free

horizon.look: the wider moral landscape of Little Kilton under overcast English skies

stage.look: the forensic staging ground where crime scene evidence is manipulated and reconstructed

abstract.look: the internal psychological space of trauma, paranoia, and moral descent

spine.claim: Trauma, insomnia, and stalking warnings consume Pip while police dismiss her desperate pleas.
Pip links local cold cases to Jason Bell as the Duct Tape Killer, finding institutions indifferent to her proof.
Ambushed in an abandoned warehouse, Pip kills Jason Bell with a hammer to survive.
Knowing police will convict her, Pip and Ravi orchestrate a forensic cover-up, corrupting their own innocence.
Pip frames unpunished rapist Max Hastings for the murder, securing survival at the cost of her moral soul.

sleuth.label: The Amateur Sleuths
sleuth.role: investigators operating outside the formal legal system
sleuth.evidence: the system forces an amateur sleuth to either accept her own murder or become a premeditated killer

police.label: Little Kilton Police
police.role: indifferent institutional authority that demands a corpse before acting
police.evidence: the institutions designed to protect us. Let's drop right into interview room 3 with DI Hawkins

predators.label: The Unpunished Predators
predators.role: serial abusers and killers sheltered by legal immunity or indifference
predators.evidence: a legal system that let a serial rapist like Max Hastings walk free and Jason Bell operate for years
